name: B2/S34 on [3^6; 3^3.4^2; 3^3.4^2; 3.4.6.4] (k4-100)
description: A 4-uniform tiling from Galebach's catalog (k4-100). Galebach 4-uniform #100 of 151. Symmetry p6m. 30 vertices per cell; 32 triangles, 12 squares, 1 hexagon. The rule was picked by surveying candidates on this tiling for one that stays active.
